name: Regions Financial

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Regions Financial Corp logo.svg)

description: Regions is a Birmingham, Alabama regional bank holding company with $158.8B of assets and $131.1B of deposits, focused on the South and Midwest. About two-thirds of its $7.5B revenue is net interest income (spread on loans and deposits) and a third is fees (service charges on deposits 635, card and ATM 487, capital markets 347, mortgage 158, wealth management). It reports Corporate Bank, Consumer Bank and Wealth Management; Consumer Bank is the largest by revenue, Corporate Bank by profit.

businessLines.name: Corporate Bank
businessLines.how: Commercial, commercial real estate and investor real estate lending, equipment leasing and treasury management for businesses; net interest income is 1,877 of 2,832 (66 percent, computed) plus fees of 955, including capital markets income (347 across the company) and service charges.

businessLines.name: Consumer Bank
businessLines.how: Branch network serving households: residential mortgages, home equity, credit cards and consumer loans; net interest income 2,937 (73 percent of revenue, computed) plus service charges on deposits, card and ATM fees and mortgage income.

businessLines.name: Wealth Management
businessLines.how: Trust, investment management, retirement and credit products for individuals, businesses and institutions: 76 percent of revenue is fees (552 of 729, computed), mainly charged as a percentage of client assets.

businessLines.name: Other
businessLines.how: Not a customer business: Treasury function, securities portfolio, wholesale funding and interest-rate risk management; 2025 net income is positive despite negative revenue because of provision and tax allocations.
